claim: On June 15, 2026, Anthropic paused its previously-announced plan to separate Claude Agent SDK/claude -p/third-party-app usage from subscription limits; nothing changed on the effective date.
stance_target: that Anthropic enforced a hard separation of programmatic usage from Claude Pro/Max subscription limits starting June 15, 2026
scope_conditions: Claude Agent SDK, claude -p, third-party apps, all subscription tiers
quoted_support: Update June 15, 2026: We've paused the previously-announced changes to Claude Agent SDK usage. For now, nothing has changed: Claude Agent SDK, claude -p, and third-party app usage still draw from your subscription limits.

claim: As of October 7, 2026, Claude Max and Team plans added monthly API credits covering the Agent SDK, claude -p, the Claude API, and Claude Managed Agents as a supplement, while subscription-limit-based usage of the Agent SDK, claude -p, and third-party apps remains available.
stance_target: that programmatic/third-party-app usage via consumer subscription credentials has been banned or fully metered away from flat-rate plans
scope_conditions: Claude Max and Team plans, effective October 7, 2026
quoted_support: Update October 7, 2026: Claude Max and Team plans now include monthly API credits, which cover the Claude Agent SDK, `claude -p`, the Claude API, and Claude Managed Agents. You can still use the Claude Agent SDK, `claude -p`, and third-party apps with your subscription limits.
